title: Pure Stardust and Majestic
summary: The Stardust and Majestic Synchro build, combining the Stardust Synchron and Stardust Trail engine with the Majestic Dragon and Arrive in Light package. Because Stardust Synchron locks the Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters for the turn, the Extra Deck holds only Synchros.

summary.title: Starters
points: Stardust Synchron tributes 1 monster to Special Summon itself from your hand or GY, then searches any Spell or Trap that mentions Stardust Dragon (Arrive in Light, Stardust Illumination, or Majestic Absorption).

Stardust Trail Special Summons itself from your hand or GY whenever a monster you control is tributed, and spawns a Level 1 Stardust Token when used as Synchro Material for a Warrior, Synchron, or Stardust Synchro.

Stardust Illumination sends a Stardust monster from your Deck to the GY (or Special Summons it if you control Stardust Dragon or a Synchro that mentions it), then banishes itself to adjust a Stardust monster's Level by 1.

summary.title: Opening: Stardust Synchron + Stardust Trail
steps: Normal Summon a monster (or summon Stardust Trail via Stardust Illumination) and tribute it to Special Summon Stardust Synchron, searching Arrive in Light.

Trigger Stardust Trail to Special Summon itself from the hand or GY, activate Arrive in Light to stack Converging Wills Dragon on top of your Deck, and Synchro Summon Level 8 Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon (or Stardust Dragon - Victim Sanctuary).
Draw Converging Wills Dragon with Arrive in Light to Special Summon it and pull Stardust Wurm or Xiaolong from the Deck, then climb into Shooting Majestic Star Dragon or Cosmic Blazar Dragon.

summary.title: Victim Sanctuary & Accel Synchro Stardust
summary.text: Stardust Dragon - Victim Sanctuary (2026 support) tributes itself to negate an opposing effect chained to your card, and once a monster has been tributed that turn, banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon another Stardust Synchro. Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon revives a Level 2 or lower Tuner on Synchro Summon and tributes itself during either Main Phase to Special Summon Stardust Dragon from the Extra Deck (treated as a Synchro Summon) and immediately Synchro Summon using monsters you control.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Shooting Majestic Star Dragon negates the effects of an Effect Monster on the field once per turn, gains an extra attack per Stardust Dragon Synchro in your GY, and banishes itself until the End Phase to negate and banish any card or effect activation.
Majestic Star Dragon negates an opposing activation and destroys all cards the opponent controls.
Cosmic Blazar Dragon banishes itself until the End Phase to negate a summon, attack, or card/effect activation.
Stardust Dragon, Stardust Spark Dragon, Shooting Star Dragon, and Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon layer destruction protection and monster negation.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Left out
points: Synchro Chase prevents the opponent from responding to your Warrior, Synchron, or Stardust Synchro effects, while Majestic Mirage revives a monster, banishes a monster, or halves damage whenever your Stardust leaves the field to activate its effect.
Majestic Absorption equips an opposing monster to Stardust Dragon or lets it attack directly, and Starlight Road punishes multi-card destruction by cheating out Stardust Dragon.
Left out: Majestic Red Dragon belongs to the Red Dragon Archfiend list, and Synchro Fellowship requires Junk Synchron and stays on the Junk/Synchron list.

main: Stardust Synchron
Tuner: tributes a monster to summon itself; searches a Stardust Dragon Spell/Trap.
Stardust Trail
Returns from the hand or GY on any tribute; leaves a Stardust Token as material.
Stardust Wurm
Joins a Level 8 Dragon Synchro; tributes itself for two Level 1 LIGHT Dragons.
Converging Wills Dragon
Majestic Tuner: summons itself when drawn; with a Level 8+ Dragon Synchro out, calls a Level 1 Dragon.
Majestic Dragon
Tuner for the Majestic Synchros only.
Satellite Synchron
Allowed Tuner: joins when a monster is summoned from your GY; becomes Level 4.
Stardust Xiaolong
Level 1 LIGHT Dragon: returns when you Synchro Summon Stardust Dragon.
Arrive in Light
Puts a Level 1 Dragon on top of the Deck; draws or summons a Tuner on Synchro Summons.
Stardust Illumination
Mills or summons a Stardust monster; shifts a Stardust's Level by 1.
Majestic Absorption
Gives Stardust Dragon an equip steal, a direct attack or burn.
Synchro Chase
Untagged: no responses to Stardust effects; revives a Synchro material.
Majestic Mirage
Revives, banishes or halves damage when your Stardust card leaves.
Starlight Road
Untagged: negates a multi-card wipe and summons Stardust Dragon.

allow.Satellite Synchron: Second Tuner for the Stardust line; it names Stardust Synchros and joins when Trail returns from the GY.
allow.Cosmic Blazar Dragon: Ultimate Synchro boss providing an all-encompassing Quick Effect negation.

exclude.Majestic Red Dragon: Needs Red Dragon Archfiend, which belongs to that list.
exclude.Synchro Fellowship: Must also add Junk Synchron, so it stays on the Junk list.
